1\. Configure Meet Alfred

7\. Define the data flow from Meet Alfred into Hubspot
8\. Build a Lead Management System in Hubspot
9\. Produce different types of reporting

Project Timeline - One week
Milestone - 500 USD

source_message.text: Meet Alfred will be needed during the project’s second phase.
